annotations.title: Fact-check an activist 13D claim against SEC Schedule 13D/13D-A

description: Use when the user wants to verify or fact-check a claim about an activist stake or 13D filing (ticker/subject, filer, percent-of-class, stated intent, timeframe). Returns confirmed (with source filing + link), not_found, partial (itemised claimed-vs-filed), out_of_scope (passive 13G isn't covered), or out_of_coverage. Every response states the coverage window checked. Caveat: filing-verified — absence is reported as absence, never guessed.

date.description: Claimed filed date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (matched ±3 filing days)

end.description: Window end (ISO) if the claim is a range

filer_name.description: Activist filer name in any order, e.g. 'Elliott Management'

form_type.description: Optional; only activist 13D/13D-A is covered — a passive 13G returns out_of_scope

intent.description: Optional pre-registered intent: I1 control/take-private, I2 board/proxy, I3 strategic/value

start.description: Window start (ISO) if the claim is a range

subject_name.description: Subject/target company name (use if you don't have the ticker)

name: verify_activist_13d
title: Fact-check an activist 13D claim against SEC Schedule 13D/13D-A
